workUnits.objective: Implement domain contracts and independent CShells features.
Compose explicit API, Console, and Worker hosts.
Generate and validate all integrator documents and sources.
Assess and enact the v1-to-v2 migration.

stopConditions: Any host selects an unpinned package.
Any reached migration boundary lacks a terminal disposition.
Any pending v1 task could run on the v2 handler.
Any generated output differs between identical invocations.
